verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents a public API that grants applications access to the account. It has list/contact endpoints with paginated collections and campaign report endpoints such as clicked reports, so an agent could pull audiences and campaign results. The only documented automation endpoint starts an automation for a contact; nothing shows that live automations can be listed or read. Probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec to help an agent. Missing for 10: an endpoint to list/read live automations and their stats, a full range of campaign reports (opens, bounces, summary), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: Use our API to give an application or website permission to interact with your EmailOctopus account.
When you request a collection of entities, such as contacts belonging to a list, the data will be paginated rather than returned all at once.
